store.tagline: Sleep, lock, restart, dark mode, volume, keep awake
features: Indexed rows with keywords, so `mute`, `sleep` or `power off` at the root finds the command
Only what this machine can run is listed: Brightness needs the `brightness` CLI on macOS, Do Not Disturb a Shortcut named "Toggle Do Not Disturb"
Empty Trash shows what is in the Trash on the right (`3 items`, `empty`); Toggle Dark Mode carries the current appearance as a tag
Keep Awake runs `caffeinate` (or `systemd-inhibit`) detached and the row flips to Allow Sleep while it runs

Quit All Apps closes every open app but Finder and pal (each asked the way its Quit menu asks, so unsaved work still prompts), Unhide All Apps brings hidden ones back, Dismiss Notifications clears what is on screen (Notification Center over Accessibility on macOS; the daemon's CLI on Linux)
Log Out, Restart, Shut Down, Empty Trash and Quit All Apps ask first, unless `confirm_destructive` is off

Quick Look Finder Selection (macOS): the Quick Look panel over what is marked in Finder, the names as the subtitle; the row is inert and says why while nothing is selected or Finder is not in front. `pal://system/run?id=quick-look-selection` for a hotkey
pal hides before running, so the command lands on the desktop, not on pal; a failure keeps the panel open with the tool's message
